info.title: FOSSBilling Extensions API (v2)
info.description: Self-service extension publishing, ownership, moderation, and public browsing. v1 (/extensions/v1) remains available for existing integrations.

spdx_id.description: A current SPDX license identifier (https://spdx.org/licenses/). Omitted for custom or proprietary licenses.
